column1: # hermes-sync.tsv — repo-owned content that also lives in a Hermes profile.
# ~/.hermes is not version controlled, so anything listed here has a copy in a
# place with no history. preflight-checks.sh B5 compares each pair and BLOCKS a
# commit while they differ, so the profile copy can never become the only copy.
# Skill directories under .agents/skills/<name> that are installed at
# profiles/<profile>/skills/travel/<name> are discovered automatically and do
# not need a line here. This file is for everything else — profile SOULs and
# any other pairing install-hermes-skill.sh cannot express (it requires a
# SKILL.md and only manages the skills/travel/ layout).
# Columns, tab-separated:  <repo path>  <profile>  <path within the profile>
# The interviewer's skill library. Nested under skills/kinerary/ rather than
# skills/travel/, so NEITHER auto-discovery nor the profile-only-skill warning
# could see it, and interview-stack-deploy only ships SOUL.md — which is how
# kinerary-intake-quality and kinerary-interview-api-notes came to exist only
# in the profile, and how a QUESTIONS.md edit sat undeployed on 2026-09-06
# while the SOUL.md change that POINTS AT IT went live. One entry, whole tree.
